decisions.reason: As an award-winning extension of the firm’s core Christmas assortment with repeated gold-medal recognition in 2023 and 2024, its value is already strongly revealed and the expected payoff from continuing clearly exceeds the low incremental cost of keeping it.

Because this bread variant remained on its own product page through 2024 while several other new breads were already removed, management would infer sufficiently positive demand to justify keeping this low-cost, close-to-core option open.

This marzipan stollen stayed in the assortment across two seasons and fits the firm’s established seasonal confectionery capabilities, so with limited carrying cost and no clear negative signal it is rational to continue offering it.
